semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides high-strength and durable iron materials critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Gwoei Metals Industry Co., Ltd specializes in the sale of raw materials and sheet metal processing, with a focus on high-strength iron materials. They are one of Taiwan's largest iron wholesalers, offering products and efficient inventory management that support various semiconductor manufacturing applications.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Gwoei Metals is one of the largest iron wholesalers in Taiwan, indicating a significant presence in the region.
